items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But I met Eric there, and then we would jam a lot, and I’d meet Eric at jam sessions.

ctx.x: You know, I didn’t know he was leaving town, and somehow I put a picture up on his birthday - Dorothy has a Facebook site for me, and so I put a picture of he and myself up, and then his son sent me an email -Anthony - saying, “My father says he loves you, and he says that Charles and I are from Memphis.” And that was so touching,

because he didn’t tell me he was from Memphis when I first came out. I didn’t know he was from Memphis at first. But I met Eric there, and then we would jam a lot, and I’d meet Eric at jam sessions. And then Eric took off cause he was playing with Chico.
